headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In other news, the Los Angeles Angels fell short in Minnesota, dropping a 3-5 decision to the Twins, while the Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with the Cincinnati Reds' Nick Lodolo being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a blister on his left index finger. The Milwaukee Brewers' Brandon Woodruff has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. The Atlanta Braves' Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The trade market has been active, with the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, failing to secure a win. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for Minnesota.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a crucial double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Reds' Lodolo Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds left-hander Nick Lodolo has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a blister on his left index finger.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers Roster**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The trade marks the latest move for the shortstop.
